user.title: Meal Plan
user.description: Set up a meal plan and shopping list. The calendars you pick are only ever read — nothing is written back to them.

options.important: Important — track from the moment it is bought
options.near_only: Only when close — there is a date, but it is weeks away

add_dish.name: Add dish to list
add_dish.description: Puts a dish's fresh ingredients on the shopping list. Pantry ingredients are reported back rather than added.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

dish.name: Dish
dish.description: The dish, by the name the household uses for it.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: A multiplier for guests. Noted on the items; nothing is calculated.

include_pantry.name: Include pantry items
include_pantry.description: Add the pantry ingredients too instead of only reporting them.

running_low.name: Running low
running_low.description: Puts one article that is running low on a list.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

when.name: Which trip
when.description: This trip, or the next one.

plan_menu.name: Plan a day
plan_menu.description: Puts a dish on a date. Never adds anything to the shopping list.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

dish.name: Dish
dish.description: Leave empty to keep the day open — that is a normal state.

note.name: Note
note.description: Free text for that day. Stays with the plan; never written to a calendar.

people.name: People
people.description: How many are eating, if it matters.

complete_all.name: Complete the list
complete_all.description: Completes everything on the shopping list, except the items you name.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

sort_list.name: Sort the list
sort_list.description: Reorders the open items into the walking route of a store.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

set_store_order.name: Set the walking route
set_store_order.description: Records the order the departments come in at a store. Meant to be corrected in the aisle, not at a desk: the open list is re-sorted straight away.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

departments.name: Departments
departments.description: Department keys, in walking order. Any left out keep their order at the end.

set_expiry.name: Set expiry date
set_expiry.description: Records when something in the house goes off.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

add_stock.name: Note what is in the house
add_stock.description: Adds something to the stock list, with or without an expiry date.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

expiry.name: Expiry date
expiry.description: Leave empty for something that simply needs using up.

learn_dish.name: Learn a dish
learn_dish.description: Adds a dish and its ingredients, or extends one that is already known.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

usual_day.name: Usual weekday
usual_day.description: If this dish tends to fall on one day.

recipe_list.name: Recipe name
recipe_list.description: The name in a recipe collection, if it differs.

learn_article.name: Place an article
learn_article.description: Puts an article in a department — the one tap that turns unknown into known.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

department.name: Department
department.description: A department key, for example produce or butcher.

shelf_life.name: Expiry tracking
shelf_life.description: Defaults to whatever the department says.

staple.name: Quick button
staple.description: Show this article as a quick button.

availability.name: Only available at
availability.description: A store name, if it is only sold there.

set_window.name: Stretch the window
set_window.description: Stretches the menu window, or puts it back to its natural length.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

extend_days.name: Extend by
extend_days.description: Days to add to the current end.

print_list.name: Print the list
print_list.description: Returns the shopping list as a printable page: one A4, two columns, department headings, a box per item.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

import_knowledge.name: Import knowledge
import_knowledge.description: Seeds departments, stores, articles and dishes from a knowledge file. An accelerator, not a prerequisite.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

replace.name: Replace departments
replace.description: Replace the department list instead of merging into it.

export_knowledge.name: Export knowledge
export_knowledge.description: Returns everything currently known, seeded and learned together, ready to be fetched.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

get_week.name: Get the week
get_week.description: Returns a week's menu with each day's calendar entries and notes.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

start.name: Start
start.description: Defaults to the current planning window.

get_history.name: Read the history
get_history.description: Returns what has happened — listed, bought, eaten, checked — most recent first. Without filters, the whole history a page at a time.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

since.name: From
since.description: Only events on or after this day.

until.name: Until
until.description: Only events on or before this day.

article.name: Article
article.description: Only what happened to this article.

dish.name: Dish
dish.description: Only what happened to this dish.

offset.name: Skip
offset.description: How many to skip — use with the total to walk through everything.

get_list.name: Read a list
get_list.description: Returns one list grouped under department headings, in the walking order of the selected store.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

list.name: List
list.description: This trip, the next trip, or what is in the house.

include_completed.name: Include completed
include_completed.description: Include the items already ticked off.

list_dishes.name: List dishes
list_dishes.description: Returns every dish with its frequency, last served, usual weekday and ingredients.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

get_pantry_check.name: What to check
get_pantry_check.description: Returns the pantry articles worth checking you still have.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

scope.name: Scope
scope.description: Everything due by its cadence, or the pantry items of the planned menu.

get_expiring.name: What is expiring
get_expiring.description: Returns what goes off within a number of days.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

suggest_menu.name: Suggest a menu
suggest_menu.description: Suggests dishes for the empty days. Dishes only — never a shopping list.

entry_id.name: Meal plan
entry_id.description: Which meal plan. Optional if there is only one.

start.name: Start
start.description: Defaults to the current planning window.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days to suggest for.

limit.name: Candidates per day
limit.description: How many suggestions to return per day.
